old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a green plastic tray placed on what appears to be a radiator or a similar surface. On the tray, there is a white, creamy substance that resembles a dollop of sour cream or a similar food item. As the video progresses, the substance begins to melt and spread out, forming small bubbles on its surface. The melting process continues, causing the substance to spread further across the tray. The background remains static throughout the video, with no significant changes in lighting or additional elements entering the frame. The focus remains solely on the melting substance and its gradual transformation.

caption: The video captures a square green plastic lid resting on a white surface, with dark vent slats visible beneath its lower edge against a pale wall. Atop the lid sits a thick, pale-yellow viscous blob bearing a notch cut into its left side, ringed by scattered small white droplets and a thin glossy liquid film. The blob stays in place while a slow spreading process continues around its edges. White liquid pooling in the left notch and along the lower-left rim widens, drawing out a thin trailing stream toward the lower-left. The droplets at the bottom and right merge and grow slightly as the surrounding film creeps outward. Bright elongated reflections streak across the glossy tray surface, fixed as the liquid creeps.

An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.

processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.
